call112Aria: Call 112, the emergency number for police, fire and ambulance
emptyBody: We are collecting the police station list, crime figures from the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) and traffic fine data. NCRB publishes district figures once a year.
explainStations: Our list has {n, plural, one {# police station} other {# police stations}} in {district}.
explainPhones: {phones, plural, one {# of them has a phone number} other {# of them have a phone number}}: tap a station to call it.
explainCrimeUp: The National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) counted {count} cases in {year}, {pct} more than in {prev}.
explainCrimeDown: The National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) counted {count} cases in {year}, {pct} fewer than in {prev}.
explainCrimeSame: The National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) counted {count} cases in {year}, the same as in {prev}.
explainCrimeOne: The National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) counted {count} cases in {year}.
explainCrimeTypes: Crime figures from the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) for {year} are below, by type of crime.
pictureNote: These are all the cases counted by the National Crime Records Bureau. More cases can also mean that more people came forward to report a crime.
how1Body: Police, fire and ambulance. Free from any phone.
how2Body: Every station must take your complaint, even for a crime outside its area (Zero FIR).
how3Body: The police must give you a copy of the First Information Report (FIR) without charge.
how4Body: If the station will not register it, send your complaint in writing to the Superintendent of Police (SP).
stationsHint: Tap a station to see its phone number, officer in charge and address.
searchPlaceholder: Type a station or area name
sheetNote: Phone numbers and officers change. If this number does not answer, call 112.
crimeUnits: Number of cases recorded by NCRB in each type.
crimeUnitsTotal: Number of cases recorded by NCRB in each type. The total is not drawn as a bar because it already includes these.
crimeSimple: The biggest group is {name}, with {n, plural, one {{count} case} other {{count} cases}}.
trendUnits: Cases of the same type in {prev} and in the latest year. Only types recorded in both years are shown.
trendSimple: Cases went up in {up} of {n} {n, plural, one {type} other {types}} between {prev} and {latest}.
trafficUnits: Thousand rupees collected from traffic challans each month.
trafficSimple: The highest month on file is {month}, with ₹{amount} thousand collected.
trafficSimpleTarget: In {month}, ₹{amount} lakh was collected against a target of ₹{target} lakh.
staffExplain: {working} of {sanctioned} sanctioned police posts are filled. {vacant} are empty.
staffPicto: About {n} of every 10 posts are filled.
allFiguresSummary: Show all {n, plural, one {# figure} other {# figures}} with their sources
